name: am-tax-overview
description: Use as the 2026 Armenian country entry point for personal income tax, company profit tax, VAT, pension and other social payments, payroll, transfer pricing and cross-border questions. Routes individuals, registered entrepreneurs, resident organisations, non-residents and permanent establishments to the appropriate detailed Guide. Highlights the distinction between headline rates, a legally established tax base, special-regime eligibility and year-specific annual filing dates. Also routes incorporation and business-regime comparison questions to the supporting Guides. This overview is a map, not a complete computation or taxpayer classification. All seven tax domains apply. The detailed Guides supply all seven ordinary domains, including the statutory benefit minimum, Service payment route and current SRC treaty-refund application/approval/account method. Independent source-review records and remaining specialist/operational boundaries are preserved; named professional attestation remai
